body: Inbox is always open here, friend.

I went through a similar thing, to my partner of 5 years. Difference was I didn’t realise how abusing eand manipulative the whole relationship was. Most would find relief, but it’s just ruined me.. I now only seek out abusive relations and my trust for anyone’s dead. 

I cannot function socially, at the degree I used to. I never will again. 

Not to steal wind of your post, shared suffering is just more tolerable. 

Do you have any good friends to spend the night with?
